task.description: New work: a self-contained assignment. An existing window: only what changed or comes next, since it already holds its assignment and history. With answer_to: the answer.

task_id.description: new for new work, or an existing window's task_id to continue its work.

profile.description: Only with new, to use a named profile: its ID from `browser.windows`. Omit it for the default profile.

tab.description: Only with an existing window: a tab ID from `browser.windows` to work in.

url.description: Only an address the user gave, one from a tool result such as a search result, or a well-known site whose address you are sure of. Never build one from a business or product name; omit it and name the business and its location in task.

file.description: A workspace file to grant. The browser receives the file, never its path.

verification_code.description: A one-time code reference for a sign-in, from a protected read. The user approves sharing the code before the browser receives it. With answer_to it reaches only the step that asked; without it, it goes to the sign-in on its site.

credential_id.description: The UUID from the protected read's credential marker, never the code itself.

origin.description: The exact HTTPS origin of the active sign-in challenge.

account_hint.description: The account to sign in with: the one the user named, or the email or phone number their memory or files give for that site. With answer_to it reaches only the step that asked; without it, the window's sign-ins use it.

answer_to.description: Only to answer a browser question of an existing window: the question_id from that question. A call without answer_to is an update for the browser agent.

wallet.description: Set only when the user explicitly chose a wallet provider and card, including a choice in memory or their shopping profile. Omit when no wallet card was chosen. On an existing task, omission preserves its choice; null clears it. Put a preference for a merchant-saved card in task and leave wallet unset.

payment_method_id.description: The exact payment-method ID, every character preserved.
